  "decision-cost-project-issues-from-fifo-layers": "WITH issues AS (
  SELECT project_code, issue_units, SUM(issue_units) OVER (ORDER BY issue_seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS issue_end
  FROM project_issue
), lots AS (
  SELECT unit_cents, lot_units, SUM(lot_units) OVER (ORDER BY lot_seq ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS lot_end
  FROM store_lot
), allocations AS (
  SELECT i.project_code, l.unit_cents, MIN(i.issue_end, l.lot_end) - MAX(i.issue_end - i.issue_units, l.lot_end - l.lot_units) AS units
  FROM issues AS i
  JOIN lots AS l ON i.issue_end > l.lot_end - l.lot_units AND l.lot_end > i.issue_end - i.issue_units
)
SELECT project_code, SUM(units) AS issued_units, SUM(units * unit_cents) AS material_cents
FROM allocations
GROUP BY project_code
ORDER BY project_code ASC",
  "decision-count-menu-options-with-complete-labels": "WITH dishes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT course_code, dish_code FROM menu_slot
)
SELECT d.course_code, COUNT(*) AS listed_dishes,
       SUM(CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM filter_tag AS f
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM dish_label AS l
           WHERE l.dish_code = d.dish_code AND l.tag_code = f.tag_code AND l.mark = 'free'
         )
       ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS qualifying_dishes
FROM dishes AS d
GROUP BY d.course_code
ORDER BY d.course_code ASC",
  "decision-cover-two-strip-orders-with-opening-fees": "WITH counts(n) AS (VALUES (0), (1), (2), (3))
SELECT t.ticket_id, a.n AS p_rolls, b.n AS q_rolls,
       a.n * p.run_cents + b.n * q.run_cents
       + CASE WHEN a.n > 0 THEN p.open_cents ELSE 0 END
       + CASE WHEN b.n > 0 THEN q.open_cents ELSE 0 END AS total_cents
FROM shift_ticket AS t
JOIN slit_pattern AS p ON p.pattern_id = 'P'
JOIN slit_pattern AS q ON q.pattern_id = 'Q'
CROSS JOIN counts AS a
CROSS JOIN counts AS b
WHERE a.n + b.n <= t.roll_limit
  AND a.n * p.narrow_yield + b.n * q.narrow_yield >= t.narrow_need
  AND a.n * p.wide_yield + b.n * q.wide_yield >= t.wide_need
ORDER BY total_cents ASC, a.n + b.n ASC, a.n ASC
LIMIT 1",
  "decision-crate-destination-receipt-audit": "WITH proposed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT crate_code, bay_code FROM routing_slip
), disputed AS (
  SELECT crate_code FROM proposed GROUP BY crate_code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
), receipts AS (
  SELECT e.crate_code, e.bay_code, e.source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.crate_code ORDER BY e.shift_min ASC, e.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS receipt_rank
  FROM dock_evidence AS e
  JOIN proposed AS p ON p.crate_code = e.crate_code AND p.bay_code = e.bay_code
  WHERE e.event_kind = 'receipt'
)
SELECT d.crate_code, r.bay_code AS accepted_bay, r.source_id
FROM disputed AS d
LEFT JOIN receipts AS r ON r.crate_code = d.crate_code AND r.receipt_rank = 1
ORDER BY d.crate_code ASC"
}

  SELECT crate_code FROM proposed GROUP BY crate_code HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
), receipts AS (
  SELECT e.crate_code, e.bay_code, e.source_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.crate_code ORDER BY e.shift_min ASC, e.source_id COLLATE BINARY ASC) AS receipt_rank
